conversation.speaker: Customer
conversation.text: I want to close my savings account. The branch keeps delaying it!

conversation.speaker: RM
conversation.text: I’m sorry for the delay Sir. Can you share your account number so I can assist?

conversation.speaker: Customer
conversation.text: It’s nine five five two nine four seven eight eight two. I just want this done quickly.

conversation.speaker: RM
conversation.text: I understand. There’s a pending balance of ₹500. Would you like to transfer it or receive a cheque?

conversation.speaker: Customer
conversation.text: Transfer it to my other bank. This is taking too long!

conversation.speaker: RM
conversation.text: I’ve initiated the closure and transfer. It’ll be completed in 3 days. I’ll send a confirmation.
